warnings: Starter guide. Your store can replace it with its own steps in Harbor later.

steps.title: Pre-check the device
steps.detail: Touch, display, cameras, Face ID / fingerprint, speakers, charging. Note anything not working before you open it.

steps.title: Power off and open
steps.detail: Remove the bottom screws if it has them, warm the edges, lift with a suction cup and pry gently.

steps.title: Disconnect the battery first
steps.detail: Then the display connectors.

steps.title: Move over any parts the new screen needs
steps.detail: Earpiece, sensors, brackets. Compare the old and new screen side by side.

steps.title: Test before sealing
steps.detail: Connect the new screen and test touch, brightness and the sensors with the phone open.

steps.title: Seal and post-check
steps.detail: New adhesive, screws back in, then repeat the pre-check with the customer.

warnings: Never puncture or bend a swollen battery. Bag it and take it back to the store.

steps.title: Pre-check and note battery health
steps.detail: Write down the battery health or cycle count if the phone shows it.

steps.title: Open the device
steps.detail: Follow the screen or back glass opening steps for this model.

steps.title: Disconnect the battery
steps.detail: Before touching anything else.

steps.title: Release the adhesive
steps.detail: Use the pull tabs or adhesive remover. Don't pry against the battery.

steps.title: Fit the new battery and test
steps.detail: Connect, power on, check charging and the battery reading.

steps.title: Close up and post-check
steps.detail: Repeat the pre-check with the customer.

warnings: Glass shards: wear eye protection and keep the customer back while you work.

steps.title: Pre-check
steps.detail: Cameras, flash, wireless charging, buttons.

steps.title: Remove the back glass
steps.detail: Use the laser machine at the store, or heat and careful prying on a housing swap.

steps.title: Clean the frame
steps.detail: No glass or adhesive left on the edges or camera ring.

steps.title: Fit the new back glass
steps.detail: Line up the camera cutout first, then press down evenly.

steps.title: Post-check
steps.detail: Cameras, flash and wireless charging.

steps.title: Try cleaning first
steps.detail: Lint in the port is the most common cause. Check with a light.

steps.title: Pre-check
steps.detail: Charging with two known-good cables, data, mic, speaker.

steps.title: Swap the port assembly
steps.detail: Move over the speaker and antenna parts if the new one needs them.

steps.title: Post-check
steps.detail: Charging, data, mic and speaker.
